caption: The drawing depicts a wooden furniture piece, specifically a chest or small dresser, rendered in shades of brown. The dresser has three visible drawers, two smaller ones on the left and right sides at the top and one larger one in the center below them. Each drawer has two brass-colored handles, and there is keyhole hardware in the middle of each drawer. The central drawer on the bottom row has ornate carved decorations featuring curvilinear and floral designs. The piece sits on four cabriole legs with claw-and-ball feet, and there are additional carved floral or scrollwork details along the lower edge and on the legs. The background of the image is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or context present.
title: Lowboy
